# Fallon Scott

> Fallon Scott, CPA, is a fractional COO and the founder and principal of F28 & Co. (https://f28co.com), the Atlanta operations consulting firm that builds businesses able to grow beyond their founders. Auditor turned operator: former KPMG auditor and founding member of Delta Air Lines' Internal Audit and Enterprise Risk Management practice. CPA and Lean Six Sigma certified. Co-founder of The Makenzie House, a wedding and event venue that grew revenue 11x in 12 months.

fallonscott.com is Fallon's founder site: her story, point of view, speaking and the SOP Suite. Services, the team and partners live on f28co.com. F28 & Co. has an in-house team plus vetted partners; Fallon sets direction and personally leads select engagements. She holds two fractional COO seats at a time.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://fallonscott.com/): Who Fallon is and how to work with her and F28 & Co.
- [About](https://fallonscott.com/about.html): Career story. KPMG (2010 to 2012), Delta Air Lines Internal Audit and ERM (2012 to 2015), sales and marketing leadership scaling a 6,000-person team (2015 to 2019), F28 Agency and then F28 & Co. with 60+ process engagements (2019 to present), The Makenzie House co-founder (2022 to present).
- [AI readiness](https://fallonscott.com/ai-systems.html): Fallon's view on where AI earns its place, the manual-work cost calculator, AI maturity levels, and why governance comes before integration. Services: https://f28co.com/ai-readiness/
- [SOP Suite](https://fallonscott.com/sop-suite.html): Self-serve system to document, prioritize and delegate the work in a business. Walkthrough videos, masterlist, prioritization plan, fillable SOP templates. $998.
- [Built to Transfer](https://fallonscott.com/built-to-transfer.html): Free 5-minute Exit Readiness check for owners who want a business that can run, sell or transfer without them.
- [Speaking](https://fallonscott.com/speaking.html): Keynotes, workshops, panels and podcasts on operations, AI readiness, key-person risk and exit readiness.
- [Work with me](https://fallonscott.com/work-with-me.html): Ways to engage.
- [FAQ](https://fallonscott.com/faq.html)
- [Resources](https://fallonscott.com/resources.html): Articles, frameworks and field notes.

## F28 & Co. service areas (https://f28co.com/what-we-cover/)
- Operations & Process: fractional COO, operational assessments, process maps, SOPs, AI and automation
- Talent & Team: hiring systems, org design, training and LMS, recruiting; executive search through partners
- Technology & Security: AI readiness and governance, ISO/IEC 42001 and 27001 readiness, cybersecurity, custom platforms
- Sales & Marketing: strategy, SEO, GEO and AI visibility; brand, PR and paid ads through partners
- Financial Management: CPA-led financial operations; bookkeeping, tax and fractional CFO through partners
- Succession & Exit: exit readiness, owner-dependency reduction, succession; valuation and M&A through partners
- Growth Capital & Funding and Legal, Risk & Compliance: through vetted partners, with F28 preparing the operation

Engagement pricing is scoped after a discovery call. The SOP Suite is the only published price.
